title: A Society of Researchers: Designing Institutions for Populations of Autonomous Research Agents
summary: 为一万个自主研究智能体设计制度规则（竞标、评审、拨款），模拟科研机构的资源分配机制，有团队报告同质量下减少约30%算力
body:
为一万个自主研究智能体设计制度规则（竞标、评审、拨款），模拟科研机构的资源分配机制，有团队报告同质量下减少约30%算力

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10468
summary_en: This note discusses designing institutional rules for populations of ten thousand autonomous research agents, including mechanisms for bidding, peer review, and funding allocation. The project simulates resource distribution in scientific institutions. A participating team reportedly achieved approximately 30% reduction in computational power requirements while maintaining equivalent output quality, demonstrating improved efficiency.
